section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1984
title: 28 total suicides were committed by this method. The other second important means used for committing suicides was by 'Hanging' and 23·9 per cent of the total suicides were committed by this method during 1984 followed by 'Drowning' (14·9%), by 'Fire' (9·4%), by 'Railways' (5·4%), by 'Jumping' (1·1%), by 'Firearms' (0·8%) by 'Weapons' (0·5%) and by 'Taking sleeping pills' and by 'Touching electric wire' each (0·3%) while 11·7 per cent of the total suicides registered during 1984 was shared by the suicides grouped under 'Other causes'. The details are presented in Table-IV. TABLE-IV
